notes:
Company notes: mid-market B2B SaaS (in-app customer support/chat). Currently running POC using Redwood Hosted API after repeated latency regressions with incumbent (OpenAI). Product PM + infra lead very focused on first-token & streaming SLOs (aiming <200ms first byte median for triage responses). Interested in Hosted for fast time-to-value but evaluating Dedicated for predictable latency/cost at scale.

POC summary (high level):
- POC start: 2024-11-07, scope: core chat UI (streaming), tool-calling (search + ticket creation), fallback routing for long context.
- Benchmark approach: 10k synthetic conversations from production traces, 10 concurrent users ramp to 200, mix of short queries and tool calls. Compared Redwood streaming vs incumbent API under steady and burst load.
- Findings (quoted from PM): "Streaming responsiveness is huge — users notice partial responses. Incumbent regressed last 6w, spikes to 700-900ms for first byte."
- Redwood results (Host API): median first-byte latency 120ms, p95 260ms; end-to-end tool-call flow (search + call) median 220ms vs incumbent median 620ms. Consistent lower tail.
- Incumbent (OpenAI) observed: median first-byte 340-380ms in our traces during POC window; p95 750-920ms under burst. Caused visible UI jitter and session timeouts on mobile.

Operational notes:
- SE-led bench (Lena) ran side-by-side streaming tests; also validated function/tool calling reliability (1000 calls, ~99.4% success under load).
- Memory/caching: Redwood prefix/KV caching reduced token cost on long sessions by ~18% in POC.
- Cost: initial hosted estimates look competitive given lower latency (fewer re-requests). Procurement flagged variable pricing vs committed Dedicated discount.

Security/compliance:
- Need SOC2 attestation and SSO/SAML integration; KMS integration required for encrypting certain PII fields. Data residency note: US + EU customers require EU residency option for subset of customers.

Quotes & friction: 
- PM: "If we can hit <200ms median for streaming in prod, we can de-risk the release"
- Infra lead: wants Dedicated sizing and autoscale policy details; asked for GPU footprint and expected concurrency guidance.
- Procurement: wants a 12-month committed pricing option and clarified SLAs around p95 latency for Dedicated.

Next steps (explicit):
- Exec-level demo scheduled 2024-12-11 (Samir to present, SE + PM on call).
- Provide Dedicated sizing + committed pricing sheet (deliver by 2024-12-06).
- Legal to share KMS integration spec and SOC2 artifacts; EchoAssist to run internal security review (due 2024-12-20).
- Follow-up: confirm routing/fallback plan for region failover and cold-start behavior.

Other CRM tidbits: notes are fragmented in calls, some duplicate items across threads, active follow-up required on pricing cadence.
